speaker: President Trump / Congress
venue: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act of 2026 (S. 3971)
points: Ended a 195-day lapse (Oct 1, 2025 – Apr 13, 2026) when no new SBIR/STTR awards could be made.
New Phase II 'strategic breakthrough' awards up to $30M; tighter foreign-risk screening.
From FY27, agencies may cap proposals per company, solicitation or topic.
um_relevance: SBIR is back and bigger. A $30M strategic-breakthrough Phase II is a realistic medium-term target once Phase I/II data exists. Per-company proposal caps from FY27 mean UM should pick topics deliberately.

speaker: Congress / President
venue: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027 (H.R. 6500, P.L. 119-103), signed 2 Sep 2026
quote: (CR) Funding through December 11, 2026 at FY26 levels; no new production starts
points: Senate passed it 90-6 (8 Aug) and the House 370-48 (1 Sep); signed 2 Sep 2026.
Most programs held at FY26 levels until 11 Dec 2026.
Bars DoW funds for new production starts, new multiyear contracts or production-rate increases unless the CR says otherwise.
The $350B defense reconciliation request (which carries most 'Drone Dominance' money) is uncertain.
um_relevance: Near-term (Q4 2026) money comes from existing lines: RDT&E, O&M, prototyping (OTA), SBIR, and orders on already-awarded IDIQs. New C-UAS production starts wait for full-year appropriations.
